title: Do Larger Fully Connected Neural Networks Generalize Better?
abstract: arXiv:2611.29039v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Greater neural-network capacity does not necessarily yield better performance on unseen data. This study investigates whether a deeper, fully connected neural-network architecture generalizes better than a shallower architecture on the Fashion-MNIST dataset. We compare two architectures under two learning rates and two L2-regularization settings, producing eight configurations. The architectures contain 95,410 and 561,470 trainable parameters, respectively, an approximately 5.9-fold difference. Checkpoints and the final configuration are selected by validation loss, and all configurations are evaluated on a held-out test set. The selected larger configuration achieves 89.82% validation accuracy and 88.77% test accuracy. Selecting the lowest-validation-loss configuration within each architecture yields test accuracies of 88.77% and 88.52%, respectively, a difference of 0.25 percentage points. translated_title: 更大的全连接神经网络泛化能力更好吗？
translated_abstract: 更大的神经网络容量并不一定能在未见过的数据上带来更好的性能。本研究探究了在Fashion-MNIST数据集上，更深的全连接神经网络架构是否比更浅的架构具有更好的泛化能力。我们在两种学习率和两种L2正则化设置下比较两种架构，共产生八种配置。两种架构分别包含95,410和561,470个可训练参数，相差约5.9倍。检查点和最终配置通过验证损失进行选择，所有配置均在留出的测试集上进行评估。所选的更大配置达到了89.82%的验证准确率和88.77%的测试准确率。在每个架构内选择验证损失最低的配置，得到的测试准确率分别为88.77%和88.52%，仅相差0.25个百分点。在匹配的训练设置下，更大的架构……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究通过在Fashion-MNIST上的受控对比实验发现，参数量约为5.9倍的更大全连接网络仅比小网络的测试准确率高0.25个百分点，表明更大的模型容量并不能带来显著的泛化性能提升。
en_tdlr: This study shows through controlled experiments on Fashion-MNIST that a fully connected network with about 5.9× more parameters achieves only 0.25 percentage points higher test accuracy than a smaller one, indicating that greater model capacity does not substantially improve generalization.
